transcript: Checkout API prod mein deploy v2.8.1 ke baad 5xx errors aaye aur kuch payments fail ho gaye. Users checkout complete nahi kar paa rahe the.
impact_summary: Some users could not complete checkout.

transcript: Checkout prod slow chal raha tha, requests timeout ho rahi thi; kuch payments complete nahi ho rahe the.
Auth API production mein login failures aur 401 errors dikhe. Existing sessions kuch users ke liye refresh nahi ho rahe the.
impact_summary: Some users could not refresh their sessions.

transcript: Search API prod mein high latency thi aur search results dheere aa rahe the.
Checkout production mein 500 errors ke saath payment errors aaye, rollback ke baad requests recover hue.
